title: nickel free stainless stock pot
text: nickel free stainless stock pot. This pot is heavy and huge and beautiful.  It has a clear glass lid.  Beautifully shiny on the outside.  Came with a stainless ladle and fry dip/strainer that I wasn't expecting... although the care instructions say not to use metal utensils - they recommend wood, silicone or other non metal.  Hmmm.  The gifted utensils appear to be stainless too. The other thing that was a little distressing was the instructions to "season" your new pot.  There are two full pages of how to do this.  Yikes.  It says to do this if you live in a humid area or don't use the pan often, they recommend it.  Well. It's a HUGE pot and I plan to use a couple times a year.  But I am not really thrilled about the HUGE process of the seasoning. Having said all of these things, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
